# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 62 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Word Counter** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/word-counter/), a free online word counter — paste text to see words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading and speaking time and keyword density, all computed locally, **Gas Fee Dashboard** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/gas-tracker/), a free online gas-price board — slow, standard and fast prices across six chains with a congestion meter and transfer and swap cost estimates in dollars, from clearly labelled demo data, **Funding Rate Arbitrage Calc** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/funding-arbitrage/), a free online cash-and-carry calculator — enter spot and perp prices, notional, funding rate and holding period to see funding per interval, daily and annualised funding, fees, breakeven and net P&L, all computed locally, **Game of Life** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/game-of-life/), a free online Conway's Game of Life — paint cells on a 48×32 grid, run Glider, Pulsar and Gosper Glider Gun presets, with speed, wrap-around and randomise controls, all in the browser, **Text Diff** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/text-diff/), a free online text comparison tool — paste original and revised text to see a side-by-side line diff with word-level highlighting, added/removed/changed counts and an ignore-whitespace toggle, all computed locally, **Pocket Piano** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/pocket-piano/), a free online playable piano — two octaves with sustain, multiple voices and computer-keyboard playing, synthesized with WebAudio, all in the browser, **Trading Journal** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/trading-journal/), a free online trading journal — log long and short trades and get win rate, profit factor, expectancy, average win/loss and total P&L automatically, with local storage and CSV export, all computed locally, **Pong vs AI** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/pong/), a free online pong game — play the 1972 classic against a three-difficulty AI with mouse, touch or keyboard control, first to 7 wins, all in the browser, **Hash Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/hash-generator/), a free online developer tool — hash text or files with SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 in the browser, with hex/base64 output, one-click copy and a compare-two-hashes check, nothing ever leaves the page, **Metronome** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/metronome/), a free online music practice tool — set any tempo from 30 to 240 BPM with tap tempo, four time signatures with accented downbeats, WebAudio clicks and a large visual pulse, all in the browser
